definition: Trains a signed distance function (SDF) network using point cloud data and Eikonal regularization to enforce unit gradient magnitude.
summary: SDF Training with Eikonal Loss trains an MLP to predict a Signed Distance Function by enforcing unit gradient magnitude, ensuring valid geometry and suppressing noise.
